about.title: A program that revives meaning
about.p1: Ihyaa is a youth initiative that revives Islamic values in the hearts of young people through inspiring gatherings, diverse activities, and meaningful content.
about.p2: We believe the new generation can drive change when it finds a nurturing space that unites spirit, mind, and action.
about.quote: “The best of people are those most beneficial to others.”
about.cardGatheringsDesc: Circles and lessons that unite hearts around knowledge.
about.cardActivitiesDesc: Sports, trips and volunteering that build brotherhood.
about.cardContentDesc: Articles and media that inspire and enrich.
